name: Doodieman Voodoo
summary: This game is truly disgusting and is not for the feint hearted. You must fire poo at a voodoo dummy in a variety of different ways. Doodieman will shoot poop high into the air, flip it off his head, and even bounce it across a trampoline! Choose from the 10 different methods and watch as Doodieman covers the target in heaps of brown smear. Although this game is disgusting, you will find the different animations hilarious as well as gross!
